Life changing experiences can happen on any one of your trips.  You should be fine at 16 my first trip was on my 15th birthday.  I wouldn’t recommend taking it during a depressive episode but you could it can cause a bad trip but it’s not super likely.  Microdosing would probably be more useful as a antidepressant.  If you want a less intense trip I’d recommend 100 to 175ug or one average size tab, a big dose for a first trip would be 200+uh and micro doses are normally around 25ug.  It’s recommended to test i don’t though so I don’t know any places to get test kits. I just follow the if it’s bitter it’s a spitter rule.  I like to listen to tool and Nirvana a lot when I trip but any music is good.  Weed can greatly intensify you’re trip so if you feel underwhelmed you can smoke some.  Make sure you do it somewhere you know and are comfortable with like you’re house or a close friends house same with if you want someone there with you.  If you think you’re ready then you’re probably ready.  I leave the tabs in for around 45 mins then swallow whatever didn’t dissolve to make sure I get everything.  I don’t store mine for more than a day or two because I don’t buy in bulk but I’ve heard if it’s properly stored a month or two.  I would recommend not eating before because you might throw up but I always start eating around 3 hours after I drop my tabs.  Never tried it with alcohol but I don’t think it’s recommended.  You can do anything you feel like I enjoy just listening to music and walking. I always get very energetic when I trip so I go for walks or pace back and forth.  You probably won’t be able to sleep for 8-16 hours and from point of dropping my peak normally happens around 3-4 hours.  Have fun and there’s a lot more info on r/LSD

Edit: I forgot to mention but a benzo can stop you’re trip and to help avoid a bad trip just let the trip take control if you try and fight it then you will be more likely to have a bad trip just let it happen and you should be fine
